None of the watches I've shown you have a leather strap, so there isn't one in this lineup to check on. That's by design, since leather and his daily swim don't mix well, it tends to absorb water, stiffen, and break down with regular exposure.

If a leather look appeals to him for occasional dress-up wear separate from his swim watch, that's a different conversation, but for the one watch that needs to do both jobs, I'd stay with the stainless steel bracelets I've pulled. Want me to keep narrowing within these, maybe by brand or price?

turns.reply:
Case size really comes down to his wrist and taste more than a hard rule, but since he's active, a slightly larger, sturdy case tends to read well and stays easy to glance at mid-workout.

Looking at what's on the shelf now, the Invicta Speedway runs biggest at 50mm, a bold, statement size. The Pro Diver sits at 45mm and the Oceanaut Escapade and Duxot Accelero are more middle-of-the-road, versatile for both the gym and a dress shirt cuff.

If he tends to wear his sleeves rolled up or likes a watch that makes a statement, I'd lean toward the Speedway. If you want something that disappears a bit more under a cuff, the Escapade or Accelero size would suit better. Want me to narrow to one of those sizes?
